premise: Canon-derived functional discovery lenses generate candidate structural gaps. They do not establish facts.

lenses.name: FUNCTION
lenses.question_job: Discover what the thing actually does or changes.

lenses.name: SOURCE
lenses.question_job: Discover where authority, instruction, truth, provision, or governing order originates.

lenses.name: CARRIER
lenses.question_job: Discover who or what bears, transmits, represents, or executes received responsibility or authority.

lenses.name: BOUNDARY
lenses.question_job: Discover where a role, rule, authority, domain, claim, object, or responsibility starts and stops.

lenses.name: STATE
lenses.question_job: Discover the material condition before or after an event or operation.

lenses.name: TRIGGER
lenses.question_job: Discover the event or condition that changes state, responsibility, permission, custody, or obligation.

lenses.name: CUSTODY
lenses.question_job: Discover what entrusted thing or condition must be guarded, preserved, transferred, or accounted for.

lenses.name: ACCESS
lenses.question_job: Discover who may approach, enter, see, receive, touch, change, approve, use, or remain.

lenses.name: PREPARATION
lenses.question_job: Discover what must be ready or fit before participation or execution.

lenses.name: INTAKE
lenses.question_job: Discover what enters the field, from where, through what boundary, and what reception changes.

lenses.name: OUTCOME
lenses.question_job: Discover the observable fruit or resulting condition showing function fulfillment.

lenses.name: BREACH
lenses.question_job: Discover the observable condition constituting failure, disorder, invalidation, rejection, damage, or loss of fitness.

lenses.name: REPAIR
lenses.question_job: Discover restoration after breach, including authorized repair and restored-state test.

lenses.name: TIME
lenses.question_job: Discover timing, window, cadence, readiness, expiration, waiting, or fixed-time governance.

lenses.name: CONTINUITY
lenses.question_job: Discover what persists across changes of bearer, state, representation, or time.

lenses.name: EXCEPTION
lenses.question_job: Discover when the ordinary rule changes, ceases to apply, or permits a governed override.
